question: The task label matches (MCI vs normal) but the channel does not: P-117 (correct PDF S1746809423008959, Aljalal et al.) uses resting-state EEG; P-76 (Sun, Dodge & Mahoor, ESWA 238 (2024) 121929) uses facial video from I-CONECT interviews. Facial video is not EEG under any reading of the channel list. Condition 1 fails on channel.
metric: Same metric type (accuracy), but P-76's 90.63% is the best of four per-theme video-level accuracies (AUC 0.6042 on that theme).

figures.P-117: 99.81% accuracy (ensemble KNN, 11 NSGA-II channels), binary aMCI vs HC, 10-fold CV over 3660 segment feature vectors from 61 participants; no interval. Wilson 95% with n = 61: z^2/n = 0.06297; centre = (0.9981 + 0.03149)/1.06297 = 0.9686; half-width 0.0314; interval [0.937, 1.000].
figures.P-76: 90.63% = 29/32 subjects, Crafts Hobbies theme (AUC 0.6042), best of four themes (85.37%-90.63%; average AUC 0.56), K-fold CV per theme. No interval reported. Wilson with n = 32: z^2/n = 3.8415/32 = 0.12005; centre = (0.90625 + 0.06002)/1.12005 = 0.8627; half-width = 1.96*sqrt(0.90625*0.09375/32 + 3.8415/(4*32^2))/1.12005 = 0.1049; interval [0.758, 0.968].

matched_figure_check: No matched figure exists. Neither paper reports a result in the other's channel. Nothing reconciles the pair.
performance_validity: P-117 meets the Section 3.5 exclusion on its own PDF: 99.81% (>= 0.97), internal 10-fold CV over randomly split segment feature vectors, 61 participants, no external cohort (the round-20 reading's 'likely applies' is confirmed from the correct PDF). P-76's 90.63% is below 0.97 and not excluded, though its near-chance AUC (0.56 average) makes the accuracy a fragile estimate.
reason: The gap is numerically beyond uncertainty (0.9981 lies outside P-76's Wilson [0.758, 0.968]; 0.9063 lies outside P-117's [0.937, 1.000]), but EEG and facial video are different measurement channels, so condition 1 fails. P-117's 99.81% also fails the performance-validity exclusion (condition 5). The record's '90.63% Acc' omits that it is a best-of-four-themes figure on 32 subjects with AUC 0.60.

quotes.quote: With an ensemble KNN classifier, the highest accuracy, 99.81%, is achieved using 11 channels selected by an NSGA-based method.
The combined dataset has 61 people over the age of 55, including 29 amnestic MCI patients and 32 normal cases.

For evaluating the performance of each classifier, we employ 10-fold CV. This method randomly splits the dataset into ten equal subsets, with one subset used for validation (test) and the other nine for training
MC-ViViT predicts 29 out of 32 subjects correctly on the theme Crafts Hobbies, which reaches the highest accuracy, 90.63%.
The average AUC of all four themes is 0.56.
